programme.title: Jab We Met
programme.desc: The life of a suicidal industrialist takes a sharp turn when he meets a spirited chatterbox on a train journey in this breezy Bollywood romantic comedy.

programme.title: Dil Pardesi Ho Gayaa
programme.desc: This story of love across the border follows an Indian boy Arjun (Kapil Jhaveri) on a mission to rescue his brother, Major Ram (Ashutosh Rana) held captive by the Pakistani army. He chances upon a beautiful Pakistani girl named Rukhsar (Saloni Aswani) during the operation and both fall in love with each other. But their love and loyalties put them at a risk of being called traitors by their respective nations.

programme.title: SP Chauhan: A Struggling Man
programme.desc: This biopic traces the journey of Thakur Satpal Chauhan, a heroic social worker from Haryana who braved adverse social conditions to promote women's empowerment and an alcohol-free society.

programme.title: Dosti: Friends Forever
programme.desc: Karan, a wealthy young boy lives with his emotionally unavailable parents. One day, when he meets with an accident, a homeless orphan named Raj saves his life which gives rise to their unending tale of friendship and brotherhood.

programme.title: Dhamaal
programme.desc: Four slack and vagabond conmen learn about a hidden treasure from a dying thief and race against time to claim it. Meanwhile, they are also being pursued by a determined police inspector who is hell-bent on finding the treasure and keeping it all to himself.

programme.title: Raja
programme.desc: Madhu and Raja fall in love and decide to get married. However Madhu's two elder brothers oppose their alliance as Raja does not come from a wealthy family. As the story progresses the couple discovers that their families share a bitter past.
